title: My Styles and Trials
items: Save any edit or recreated style to My Styles and reuse it on new clips with one click
Trials: make 3 hook versions of a video for Instagram trial reels, enter the results, and the studio picks the winner
New videos lead with the hook type that wins for you

title: Make this, Learn tab, smoother edits
items: Make this: one click opens Claude with your Move ready, just press Enter
New Learn tab with short lessons and Do it now buttons
Library previews start on their best moment
Sharper edits: better length fitting, clearer captions placement, safer sound levels
Sound mixer stops with a clear message if a sound file is missing
Faster, sturdier license server

title: Safer loudness
items: Mixes now leave a little extra room under the peak limit, so uploads never clip
Risers build into each new section

title: Launch-film sound
items: Faceless and voiceless videos now get their own sound set, made for each video and tuned to your music's key
New mixer: every video lands at streaming loudness with no clipped clicks
Faster pace now means more cuts at the same length
Animated videos render a quick draft first, then a smooth 60 fps final

title: Updates that find you
items: If automatic updates are off, Claude offers to turn them on (at most once a week)

title: A calmer, clearer studio
items: Your first video is now one clear step at a time on Home
Library cards fill their frame and show length, shape and level at a glance
Show more adds cards without restarting the ones playing
Brand kit has a save bar and a live preview that stays in view on your phone
The dashboard opens instantly, then checks your key in the background

title: Example clips load from your key
items: Credited example clips now download once with your key and play from your own computer

title: Example clips load from your key

title: Smoother setup and a sharper library
items: Hearts on library cards now save with one tap, and your Saved count stays in sync
Setup checks for Node.js 22, tells you how long it takes, and says when a restart is all you need
On a phone, filters fold away and every button is big enough to tap
Search the style picker, and see a plain summary before the full prompt
If the internet drops, the Studio offers Try again instead of a blank page

title: Livelier library
items: The library opens on moving previews: 3D worlds, kinetic type, characters and motion design first
Previews play only while you can see them, so the page stays fast
Moves without a preview yet sit below the ones you can watch

title: Reel sound pack
items: New Reels sound pack: camera shutter, pop, whoosh, riser, impact, glitch, cash and more (33 sounds, free for commercial use)
Sound effects now follow the example's cuts

title: Trending reel styles
items: 14 new moves from top trending Instagram reels: vlog montages, viral reveals and creator looks, each with its real example

title: Smarter builds
items: Fills in any blanks in a move from your brand kit, or asks you
Your voiceover sets the length and timing
Never fetches footage or music you didn't give it
Cleans up screen recordings and other people's marks on library clips
Quality check now catches empty frames and accepts planned exits
You can set a bigger minimum text size and your own loudness target

title: Real creator styles
items: Creator Styles rebuilt from top Instagram editors: Adrian Per, Jessi Jean, Jessica Carter, Meg Kilgore, Sam Kolder, Peter McKinnon and Karen X
Every style was checked frame by frame; caption-only edits were left out
Old TikTok examples removed from Viral Formats, Vlog Edits and Creator Styles

title: Real logos
items: Videos about a real app or website now show its real logo, taken from the real page, never redrawn

title: Closer to the original
items: Studies the example in more detail: more frames, motion around each cut, and what it says
Keeps the example's shape (landscape, square or tall) and handles several clips at once
iPhone HDR clips no longer look washed out; silent clips are kept as b-roll
Uses real apps, websites and names, never made-up ones

items: An Update ready card on Home when there's a new version
Say 'update Edit Wherever' and Claude updates it in the same chat
Setup now offers to turn on automatic updates
